youtube.title: What Happened to Nerf? How Hasbro's $4 Billion Bet Left Blasters Behind
youtube.description:
What happened to Nerf? This documentary traces the nerf history of a foam ball sold in 1969 as safe to throw indoors, which grew into one of Hasbro's core brands. It follows the 2020 Nerf Elite 2.0 rebuild, the $4 billion film and TV purchase, the 2022 price rises, the 2023 job cuts and the 2024 reset with a new dart that does not fit old blasters. Fans said the blasters got weaker and Hasbro's own reports showed falling sales, so was cheap plastic the whole story?

This documentary follows the choices behind that slide: Hasbro's 2020 Elite 2.0 rebuild, the tariff pressure and the $4 billion film and TV purchase around it, the 2022 price rises, the 2023 job cuts, and the 2024 reset with a new dart that does not fit the old blasters. It also asks whether cheap plastic is the whole story.

{CHAPTERS}
